title: Experiential / player and court glyph

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Check how environmental branding reads in a close action photograph.
strategic_value: The white glyph on a vivid field can remain recognizable when the participant becomes the focus.
demonstration: A player moves across the orange-red court with a large white Instagram glyph behind.
practical_value: Use participant-scale views to check that identifying marks survive tighter crops.

content_islands.name: Player in action
content_islands.spec: Keep the moving player large within the vertical photograph.

content_islands.name: Court identifier
content_islands.spec: Retain enough of the white glyph and colored field to identify the setting.

reference_purposes.Application: The action photo shows the court identity at participant scale.
reference_purposes.Expression: The bright field and oversized white glyph remain visible behind the player.
